name: lemma_docs_mcp
description: MCP server for semantic search over a locally supplied Lemma (getlemma.com) documentation corpus. Distributes code only — no Lemma content included; see NOTICE.md.

scripts.dry-run: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js dry-run
scripts.query: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js query
scripts.test: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js test
scripts.test:fixture: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js test --fixture
